verdict.rationale: Godot officially documents building against its object-oriented engine API in GDScript, C# (on modern .NET via a dedicated .NET editor), and C++ through GDExtension, all first-party (godot-docs-8, godot-docs-1, godot-docs-2, godot-docs-24, godot-docs-26). Community reports confirm C# works but call it second-class, with fewer examples and no web export in Godot 4 (godot-comm-5, godot-comm-6). Missing for 10: in-depth evidence on the GDExtension/C++ SDK, parity of the C# binding across export targets, and AI-agent-oriented SDK docs (no llms.txt or markdown docs)
